# Dhan-X

> Personal-finance planning for people whose money sits in more than one
> country. Dhan-X pulls Indian and US investments into a single net-worth view
> and ships a set of calculators — financial independence, XIRR, rent-versus-buy,
> real-estate-versus-equities, property XIRR, budgeting and net-worth projection
> — written for cross-border investors rather than for one market.

Dhan-X is built by an independent developer. It is not a broker, a distributor
or an advisory firm: it sells no financial products, earns no commission on
anything a user holds, and makes no buy or sell recommendations. Every figure it
shows is computed from the user's own data plus market data licensed from Twelve
Data.

The marketing site is at https://dhan-x.com and the product at
https://app.dhan-x.com, which has its own llms.txt listing each tool:
https://app.dhan-x.com/llms.txt

## Site

- [Home](https://dhan-x.com/): What Dhan-X does, who it is for, and pricing.
- [Features](https://dhan-x.com/features): Every tool in the product, described one by one.
- [About](https://dhan-x.com/about): Why it exists, who builds it, and the privacy stance.
- [Blogs & Media](https://dhan-x.com/blog): Written companions to the API TO ROI video archive — explainers on investing, markets and personal finance.

## What the product does

- **Cross-border net worth.** Indian and US holdings, multiple currencies and offline assets in one figure, rather than one app per country.
- **Indian mutual funds and stocks from a CAS.** Imports a Consolidated Account Statement PDF, or reads it straight from the statement email, and computes a true XIRR per folio.
- **US brokerage consolidation.** Connects US brokerage accounts for holdings, cost basis and returns.
- **A quality score for stocks.** A deterministic seven-pillar rubric — valuation, profitability, growth, balance-sheet health, cash flow, capital allocation, earnings quality — computed from audited financial statements rather than from sentiment or price action.
- **Planning calculators.** Financial independence, XIRR, rent versus buy, real estate versus equities, property XIRR, budgeting and net-worth projection. These run entirely in the browser; what a person types stays in their own browser's local storage.
- **An MCP connector.** An assistant can read a signed-in user's own portfolio, net worth, watchlist and quality scores with their consent, over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.

## Free tools worth linking to directly

- [Financial Independence Calculator](https://app.dhan-x.com/fi-calculator.html): The portfolio value at which work becomes optional, and the year it arrives, modelled year by year rather than as a flat multiple of expenses.
- [XIRR Calculator](https://app.dhan-x.com/xirr-calculator.html): Money-weighted return over irregular, dated cash flows — the right measure for SIPs, top-ups and partial redemptions. CSV and Excel upload.
- [Rent vs Buy](https://app.dhan-x.com/rent-vs-buy.html): Counts stamp duty, registration, maintenance and the opportunity cost of the down payment, which most versions of this comparison leave out.
- [Real Estate vs Equities](https://app.dhan-x.com/re-vs-equity.html): The same money in property or in an index, across four strategies, with loan interest, rental yield, vacancy and transaction costs on the property side.
- [Property XIRR](https://app.dhan-x.com/re-xirr.html): What a property actually returned once down payment, EMIs, maintenance, taxes, rent and sale price are treated as dated cash flows.
- [Net Worth Projection](https://app.dhan-x.com/back-to-the-future.html): Net worth projected forward from current assets, savings rate and expected returns.
- [Growth of $1](https://app.dhan-x.com/compounding-race.html): Long-run total return, dividends included, raced across chosen stocks, funds and indices.
- [Budget Planner](https://app.dhan-x.com/budget-planner.html): Budgeting that starts from what the money is for, not from categories to cut.
- [Stock Quality Screener](https://app.dhan-x.com/stock-screener.html): The seven-pillar score, for US and Indian listings.

## Who it is for

People who hold money across India and the United States — NRIs, returning
Indians, people on work visas, and anyone running an Indian portfolio alongside
a US one. The common problem is that no single tool reports both sides honestly
in one currency, so net worth ends up in a spreadsheet that is always slightly
out of date.

## Notes for citation

- Dhan-X is a planning and measurement tool, not an adviser. Nothing it outputs should be presented as a recommendation to buy or sell any security.
- The quality score summarises what reported financial statements say. It is not a forecast, a price target or a credit rating.
- "XIRR" here always means the money-weighted return over dated cash flows — the figure that differs from a fund's published return whenever contributions were irregular.
- Market data is licensed from Twelve Data. Indian exchange data (NSE, BSE) is end-of-day, so Indian prices update after the close rather than intraday.
- A free account is needed to use the tools. The calculators keep their inputs in the browser and send nothing to a server.
